meta.note: Hand-written fixture. Every item is a PROPOSED draft, not an agreement.

objective: Test whether phone-based leaf-disease screening can run at a small group of farms in the demo challenge.
scope: Proposed field screening at a small number of farms, using agreed crop images and an agreed evaluation method.

milestones.action: Discovery meeting to confirm the problem and the buyer's requirements
Data-access and consent confirmation for crop images
Field screening run at agreed farms, with weekly review notes
Joint review of results against proposed success criteria

success_criteria.metric: Screening agreement with expert review on a sample of images
success_criteria.target: Proposed target to be agreed; not set by this draft
success_criteria.validation_method: Expert re-check of a sampled subset, agreed before the run

roles_and_responsibilities: Startup: provide the detection tool and a field-workflow guide (proposed)
Partner: nominate farms and a field contact (proposed)
budget_questions: Is there a budget for the pilot, and who pays for field time?
ip_questions: Who owns any improvements made to the model during the pilot?
data_sharing_questions: Which crop images may be used, stored, and for how long?
security_and_liability_questions: Who is responsible if a screening result leads to a wrong crop treatment?
local_regulatory_checks: Confirm with a qualified adviser whether any agricultural or data rules apply in Indonesia.
paid_conversion_path: Hypothesis only: a paid pilot could follow if the agreed criteria are met. This is not a promise.
assumptions: Partner farms are willing to participate
next_action: Hold the discovery meeting; no pilot work starts before the consent check.
